description: This file contains the PHP class 'Statistics' in the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Event'. It defines event handler methods related to order, review, return, and history events in the OpenCart system, focusing on updating statistical data accordingly.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Event handler class for updating statistics related to reviews, returns, orders, and order history changes.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Handles the event after a review is added, increments the review count in statistics.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Handles the event after a return is added, increments the return count in statistics.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Handles order status changes, updating order sale totals, processing, and completion statistics based on order status transitions.
